svg.title: 04 · Analyzer
svg.desc: Inside the run worker, the KPI gate answers with a preset query when one fits; otherwise the Claim Query Agent, given its cached references and examples, decides to answer, clarify or escalate and sends SQL through cli.py and the SQL guard.
svg.text: RUN WORKER · FARGATE = CLAIM QUERY AGENT
The Claim Query Agent is the run worker: one Fargate task per run, Claude Haiku on Amazon Bedrock.
